description:
Make a redo record refuse a put or delete at the event log, so the log changes only by its positioned append.

## Background

Repository deltas reject any non-append action on the event log (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs:1297`), but `RedoRecord::new` (`storage/redo_record.rs:110-130`) checks only path overlap, so a record could put or delete the log. Record tests: `storage/redo_record.rs:600-630`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `RedoRecord::new` returns an error for a put or delete at the event log, and one test owns the refusal.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Redo records refuse a rewrite of the event log
